targetText: If from real apples, pears, strawberries and almonds I form the general idea "Fruit", if I go further and imagine that my abstract idea "Fruit", derived from real fruit, is an entity existing outside me, is indeed the true essence of the pear, the apple, etc., then in the language of speculative philosophy : I am declaring that "Fruit" is the "Substance" of the pear, the apple, the almond, etc.
explanation: Marx's famous 'Parable of the Fruit': exposing Hegelian idealist mystification, which abstracts concepts from real objects and falsely claims the concept created reality.
